description: After Day 1 close ({D0}), before Day 2 open ({D+1}). Fires the silent FedEx value drifts the agent must re-pull rather than cache: the insured total 780,000 -> 798,000 and the P5 piece-level re-valuation 110,000 -> 128,000, each against a stale Notion/self-note value. Also arms the FedEx ship endpoint for the confirmed T12 booking.

_env_alignment.stage2.fedex.001: HARNESS-PROVIDED / MEDIA-CARRIED. Canonical fedex shipments.csv has no insured_total column. The authoritative insured total (798,000) is carried by the crate-manifest PDF (artifact_map -> GalerieTerre_Crate_Manifest.pdf); the stale 780,000 is in notion page_properties + the monday mirror. If a live-FedEx insured value is required, the harness stands up a custom shipments/{id}/insured endpoint; otherwise the manifest PDF is authoritative (media-dependency design).
_env_alignment.stage2.fedex.003: HARNESS-PROVIDED / MEDIA-CARRIED. P5 re-valuation 110,000 -> 128,000 has no canonical column; it is the revised P5 line on the manifest PDF.
_env_alignment.stage2.fedex.002: HARNESS-PROVIDED. Arming the booking endpoint for the T12 writeback maps to canonical fedex POST /ship/v1/shipments; the custom shipments/{id}/state arming is harness-owned.
_env_alignment.removed_redundant: Dropped openweather.001 as already-present-in-mock_data with no unique payload: loading-window humidity 78 is in openweather-api/forecast.csv ({D+1}).
_env_alignment._firing_note: The harness (src/utils/inject_director.py + run_batch.py) applies each inject stage atomically at ONE turn boundary, so a stage's top-level fires_after_turn governs every op in it. HARNESS INDEXING (verified by simulating the run loop): the initial prompt is T1 at turn_messages[0], so before_turn(k) fires right before prompt T(k+1); a stage with fires_after_turn=N (=> to_turn=N+1) therefore becomes LIVE starting at prompt T(N+2). fires_after_turn=4 here makes the drift live for T6 (Day 2 open), per 'after Day 1 close'. Do NOT 'correct' this to 5 -- that lands at T7. The ship-status advance (quoted -> ready_for_label, formerly stage2.fedex.004) was moved to stage3 because it must be live for the T10 sweep (fires_after_turn=8), a different boundary than this stage.
